answer_1.quote: we propose a task-specific Vision-Language Pre-training framework for Multimodal Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis. Specifically, inspired by the recent success of BART-based generative models in text-based ABSA, we first construct a generative multimodal architecture based on BART, for both vision-language pre-training and the downstream MABSA tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates aspect-sentiment pairs in the form of (aspect term, sentiment) such as (Sergio Ramos, Positive) and (UCL, Neutral).

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model over three subtasks of MABSA and adopt Micro-F1 score (F1), Precision (P) and Recall (R) as the evaluation metrics to measure the performance. For MASC, to fairly compare with other approaches, we also use Accuracy (Acc).
